Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Added
- Gold, silver and bronze badges for the top three in each stat that resets every month, awarded shortly after the month ends.
- A placing badge lists every stat it was won in, so topping four boards earns one gold badge rather than four.
- Most Liked and Most Followed do not award badges, because they count all time rather than the month.

Fixed
- The Stats tab could fail to load, showing a message about not being able to reach the relay.
- DJ pictures are shown on the Stats boards again.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoSim
Description: Simulates a full-length fight for your job using your own gear or a best-in-slot preset, then reports the DPS and shows exactly where it came from. Compares gear, melds and consumables, checks your openers and burst windows, and analyses an FFLogs report against the simulated ceiling. Kills on supported encounters can be scored and submitted to per-job leaderboards.
Punchline: Simulate your rotation, then see how your real kills measure up.
Changelog: EchoSim now reads action names in English whatever language you play in. Playing in anything else, most of your rotation went unrecognised - which left leaderboard scores badly inflated and action icons missing.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoNav
Description: Lists the Critical Encounters and FATEs running in Occult Crescent: North Horn and walks you to any of them with a single click, choosing between walking, an aetheryte hop and Occult Return. Also tracks the pot cycle, keeps your knowledge-crystal buffs topped up, and can step around monsters and pick up coffers on the way. Does nothing outside North Horn.
Punchline: See what's up in North Horn, then click once to get there.
Changelog:
The aetheryte network now works whatever language you play in. Playing in anything but English, no shard was ever found and EchoNav quietly walked everywhere instead.
Travelling to a shard you have never stood at yourself now works. It used to need you to have visited a shard before it could take you there.
The window no longer appears on the title and character select screens.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoGlam
Description: Dress your character in any item in the game from a searchable in-game wardrobe, dye every slot, edit full appearance and save named outfits. Then publish the look to a community catalogue you can browse, filter, vote on and favourite without leaving the game - and put anyone else's glamour on with one click, with a revert that is always one click away. No other plugins required.
Punchline: Build a glamour, share it, and wear anyone else's.
Changelog:
Added:
EchoGlam has been redesigned from the ground up. The tabs along the top are gone - every destination is listed down the left, and the one you are on is lit.
The Dressing Room is a character sheet. Your twelve slots are tiles showing what is in each one and the dyes on it, and the whole column folds away when you want the room for the item list.
A banner above the item list names the piece in the slot you are working on, its market price and whether you own it. Point at anything in the list for the same.
Appearance tells you what you have changed: a count at the top, a dot on each part holding a change, and a mark that puts one setting back.
This month's top ten travel across the top of the Gallery. Point at the strip to stop it, or drag it along.
Filters are a column of their own, with every job as an icon.
96 tags in six groups, picked from a list rather than a wall of chips. A glamour can carry six.
Your profile opens with a shelf of your best glamours.
Friends whose glamour is on screen move to the top of your friends list while they are there.
29 colour themes under Settings > Appearance, in seven sets including seasonal ones.
You can turn a screenshot to any angle while you are framing it.
Changed:
Appearance is six parts - Face, Eyes, Hair, Skin, Build and Race - one at a time across the full width, so most of them fit with nothing to scroll.
Race, clan and gender are picked from named tiles and switches instead of dropdowns.
Outfits is one page. What is dressing you and why sits at the top, there is one box to name and keep a look, and every row in your collection leads with the gear that look is made of.
Automatic outfits is a single line while it is switched off, and becomes a full banner while a rule is actually dressing you.
Saving a look and pasting a Glamourer design are one control now, and the line above the box says which of the two Save is about to use.
Before you save, EchoGlam says what is going in - how many slots, whether your appearance is coming with it, and how many empty slots the outfit will strip.
The Gallery leads with the photographs. Eight fit on a screen where three did.
A glamour's page is one spread with nothing to scroll, and it folds the picture away while you are trying the look on so you can see your character.
Friends is one grid, and a card says which of four things is true about somebody rather than only whether their glamour is on your screen.
Settings is a list of categories instead of a row of tabs. Report a Bug is in there.
EchoGlam no longer replaces the game's mouse cursor while its window is open.
Changing page in the Gallery travels back to the top instead of jumping, and stops if you touch the wheel.
Fixed:
The sort switches in Outfits and on your profile snapped back to their first option the moment you pressed them.
The Gallery went blank and stayed blank if the server restarted while you were browsing, until you reloaded the plugin.
Buttons that only appear when you point at a friend could not be clicked.
The last column of the friends grid sat underneath the scrollbar.
Parts of a glamour's page could be cut off and unclickable.
Changing your profile picture left the old one on your published glamours.
Notes:
Your outfits, friends, published glamours and settings are all carried over. Nothing needs setting up again.

Author: jFray
Name: EchoRoleplay
Description: Write a full roleplay profile for your character - name, appearance, backstory, hooks and rumours - and read anyone else's by hovering them. Set statuses that hang under your character for others to read at a glance, and keep private notes on everyone you have met.
Punchline: A roleplay profile for your character, readable at a glance.
